subject: maths
question: The mode and median of data are 36.3 and 62, respectively. What is the mean of the data? (Use the empirical formula)
solution:
**Given:**

Mode = 36.3

Median = 62

**Formula used:**

Empirical Formula:

{Mode} = 3 times {Median} - 2 times {Mean}

**Calculation:**

⇒ 36.3 = 3 × 62 − 2 × Mean

⇒ 36.3 = 186 − 2 × Mean

⇒ 2 × Mean = 186 − 36.3

⇒ 2 × Mean = 149.7

⇒ Mean = 149.7 ÷ 2 = 74.85

**∴ The correct answer is 74.85**
